g.text: Independent questions go to sub-agents, whose working is thrown away.
which files import fastllm, where does compaction fire, and what shape is df?
🤝 Delegate 3 questions in parallel: which files import fastllm?; where is
compaction triggered?; what shape is df, and what is keep?
Three answers, none of which cost you their working: fastllm is imported in
`Agent._prepare` once the turn model crosses its threshold; and `df` is (200, 2).
